problems.why: a stock exclamation that would end any story; a punchline about this one lands better

problems.phrase: Substantial buildings and hard-topped vehicles are safe options.
Others, due to poor planning, are caught outside and can’t get to a safe place.
Finally, wait 30 minutes after the last lightning or thunder before going back outside.
Start CPR or use an Automated External Defibrillator if needed.

scope: Deterministic checks: policy, spelling, facts, markup, sentence structure. Not judged: tone, flow, whether each swap took the right sense (use the judge for those).
